new_result.name: random-critical-value posterior bridge
new_result.statement: For a fixed original-coordinate invertible physical 3-block B of signature (2,1), after conditioning outside and writing c(W) for the conditional critical value, the rough majority submeasure satisfies mu_+ <= C_B dx. At any global Gaussian heat mode y_* of scale epsilon, with height M and Gibbs posterior nu, D=(y_*-c(W))/epsilon obeys nu(D>=d) <= C_B/M + exp(-d^2/2). Thus if a_d=nu(D>=d)>exp(-d^2/2), M <= C_B/(a_d-exp(-d^2/2)).
new_result.self_consistent_form: If M>=C_B and d_M=sqrt(2 log(M/C_B)), then nu(D>=d_M)<=2C_B/M.
new_result.information_form: D(nu||P)+(1/2)E_nu U^2 >= log kappa + log(a_d-exp(-d^2/2)) - log(2 pi sqrt(pi) epsilon), whenever the excess probability is positive.
